title: UK Economic Change: Causes & Effects 🌍

concepts.def: Economic gap — south is wealthier, north has lower wages.
Improving rundown areas — e.g. London Docklands (LDDC).
Cluster of high-tech firms near a university (e.g.).
Trade between countries without tariffs or quotas.
UK's 2020 departure from the European Union.
Foreign Direct Investment — overseas firms investing in UK.

walkthroughs.body_html:
The UK has a clear economic divide:

• South-East — high wages, finance, services
• North-East / Wales — old industry decline, lower wages

London's GDP per head is 2x the North-East's.

UK quaternary growth focuses around universities:

• Science Park (Silicon Fen)
• Oxford — biotech
• Manchester — graphene research

These cluster around top universities.

The UK relies heavily on trade:

• EU was largest trade partner pre-Brexit
• Post-2020: new free trade agreements (Australia, Japan)
• More paperwork for EU exports

UK is now outside the EU single market.
